lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  rw [funext_iff]
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := not_forall.1 h
  have h₀ : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by simpa [inner_self_eq_norm_sq] using (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx₀).sq_pos
  have h₁ : ContinuousAt (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) x₀ := continuousAt_inner hf.continuousAt (continuousAt_const _)
  obtain ⟨δ, δ_pos, hδ⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp h₁ ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ (by linarith [h₀])
  haveI : HasContDiffBump Y := hasContDiffBump_of_innerProductSpace Y
  let φ1 : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 4, δ / 2, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  let φ := φ1.toFun
  have hφ_test : IsTestFunction φ := ⟨φ1.contDiff, φ1.hasCompactSupport⟩
  have hφ_pos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (δ / 4), 0 < φ x := fun x hx => φ1.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hx)
  have hφ_nonneg : ∀ x ∈ Function.support φ, 0 ≤ φ x := fun x _ => φ1.nonneg x
  have hsupp : Function.support φ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ δ := by
    rw [ContDiffBump.support_eq]; exact Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)
  let g : Y → V := fun x => φ x • f x₀
  have hg_test : IsTestFunction g := IsTestFunction.smul_right hφ_test contDiff_const
  have hkey := hg g hg_test
  simp [g, inner_smul_right'] at hkey
  have h_nonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by
    intro x; by_cases hx : x ∈ Function.support φ
    · exact mul_nonneg (hφ_nonneg x hx) (by linarith [h₀, hδ x (hsupp hx)])
    · simp [Function.notMem_support.mp hx]
  have h_integrable : Integrable (fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) μ := by
    apply Continuous.mul (φ1.contDiff.continuous) (continuousAt_inner hf.continuousAt continuousAt_const) |>.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
    exact hφ_test.supp.mono (by simp)
  have hμ_pos : 0 < μ (Metric.ball x₀ (δ / 4)) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.measure_pos μ (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr (by linarith))
  have h_pos_integral_ball : 0 < ∫ x in Metric.ball x₀ (δ / 4), φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ := by
    apply integral_pos_of_nonneg h_nonneg h_integrable
    use Metric.ball x₀ (δ / 4)
    constructor
    · exact hμ_pos
    · intro x hx; exact mul_pos (hφ_pos x hx) (by linarith [h₀, hδ x (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hx)])
  have h_pos_integral : 0 < ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ := by
    calc
      0 < ∫ x in Metric.ball x₀ (δ / 4), φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ := h_pos_integral_ball
      _ ≤ ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ := by
        apply integral_mono h_integrable h_integrable
        intro x; exact le_rfl
  exact lt_irrefl _ (le_of_lt h_pos_integral (by rwa [hkey]))
